title: CroCo：基于自生成响应的跨语言对比偏好调优
summary: CroCo方法将英语中的对比偏好调优扩展到多语言场景，无需语言特定的偏好标注。通过英语奖励模型对多语言自生成响应排序，在14种高低资源语言上提升模型性能，防止灾难性遗忘，并发现在线策略数据是关键。
summary_en: CroCo extends contrastive preference tuning to multiple languages without language-specific annotations. Using an English reward model on multilingual self-generations, it improves performance across 14 languages, prevents catastrophic forgetting, and shows on-policy data is critical.
